main_body: Flat ground tile pattern (green turf with sparse tufts), repeated every 16 px. It is not a standing object.
evidence: This is a terrain tile, so the 3/4 standing-object contract does not apply. It shows no vertical face, no isometric side face and no standing object that could fail as a front elevation, a side elevation, a top-down plan or a rim-only drawing.

style.evidence: The ramp has a mid green base, a darker green and two lighter greens, about 4 steps. The tufts are small and sit at identical positions in every 16x16 tile, so the repetition is obvious. Between the tufts are wide areas of one flat base green, 5x5 px or larger, with no grain or speckle. The Beodeul grass reference has similar sparse detail but more varied clumps and an extra dark patch. This candidate is thinner and more mechanically tiled, and most tiles carry only about 4-6 colours, below the reference.
